The comparison examines the number of ADHD assessment processes completed within 90 days due to disproven suspicion (Antal udredningsforløb afsluttet indenfor 90 dage pga. mistanke afkræftet). The data is presented across two dimensions: regional distribution across Denmark and clinic-level breakdown within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]].

At the national level, the total number of these completed assessments fluctuated across three recorded years, starting at 84, peaking at 96, and dropping to 71 [^src1]. The regional data reveals a massive outlier: [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] accounts for the overwhelming majority of these cases nationally, recording 58, 82, and 43 cases across the three respective years [^src1]. In stark contrast, the trailing regions report significantly lower volumes. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] recorded only 3 cases in the first year [^src1], while [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] reported 6 cases in the first year with subsequent data suppressed or unreported [^src1]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] also trail far behind the national leader, with Midtjylland reporting 10, 10, and 20 cases, and Sjælland reporting 7, 3, and 7 cases across the three years [^src1].

Within Region Midtjylland, the data shifts to a clinic-level comparison across three periods (2022/2023, 2023/2024, and 01.04.2024-31.03.2025). Here, [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-skoleboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn]] emerges as the clear leader, particularly in the most recent period where it recorded 61 cases, a massive spike compared to just 3 cases in 2023/2024 [^src2]. [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] recorded 38 cases in the latest period [^src2]. [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-unge|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge]] and [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-udredning|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning]] trail with 31 and 12 cases respectively in the most recent period [^src2]. The most recent period shows a dramatic increase in activity across all listed clinics compared to the previous two years, indicating a significant shift in how quickly assessments are being concluded with disproven suspicions in the region [^src2].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner antallet af ADHD-udredningsforløb, der blev afsluttet inden for 90 dage på grund af afkræftet mistanke, på tværs af regioner og tre regnskabsår, og viser store regionale variationer — især at Syddanmark står for majoriteten af tilfældene.
